en: The Caṇḍikā-daṇḍaka-stotra.
Om, salutations to Śrī Caṇḍikā!
Ūm Ūm Ūm! O fierce Caṇḍī, you who are most startled by the startled, and who move with restless grace!
Durganetra has the form of the syllable *hūṃ*, *hūṃ*, *hūṃ*; he has a smiling face and holds a sword and a noose;
with the sounds *daṃ*, *daṃ*, *daṃ*, he holds a staff in his hand, sounding the *ḍamaru* drum *ḍimi-ḍimāṃ*, and wanders about subduing all.
Bhraṃ bhraṃ bhraṃ! May she whose eyes wander triumphantly; victory to Siddhicaṇḍī, homage to you! || 1 ||

Ghraṃ ghraṃ ghraṃ! Of terrible form, with a gurgling roar and a rattling sound, *huṃ huṃ huṃ*! Of laughing aspect, supported by the three worlds, the sky-farer, the protector of the field (*kṣetrapāla*). Bhrūṃ bhrūṃ bhrūṃ! Lord of spirits (*bhūtanātha*), the benefactor of all people; the *piśāca* belonging to his body.
O Siddhicaṇḍī, who removes all fear with the sounds of the syllable *hūṃ*, salutations to you! || 2 ||
*Vraṃ vraṃ vraṃ*: Terrifying as the sky, he wanders through the worlds down to the seven nether regions;
*kraṃ kraṃ kraṃ*: assuming any form at will, he is *dhadhitadhakita*; in his hand is the trident. *Druṃ druṃ druṃ*: of difficult form, his movement and the very nature of his body wander about.
Maṃ maṃ maṃ, O Siddhicaṇḍī, who has perfected the mantra and removes all fears, salutations to you! || 3 ||

Jhaṃ jhaṃ jhaṃ! She whose form is the sound *jhaṃkāra* vibrates, Jhamajhamā, Jhaṃjhamānā, pervading all directions; bearing skeletons, she is Kaṃkaṃkaṃ; Dhundhumārī, the maiden who destroys sins, has shaken away all evil.
Dhūṃ dhūṃ dhūṃ! Smoke-colored, she wanders through the worlds, wielding the trident of the Lord of Death.
O Siddhicaṇḍī, who takes on various intense forms and removes my fear, salutations to you! || 4 ||

Raṃ raṃ raṃ! O Rāyarudra, who has swallowed blood, who is formidable with a long tongue, Paṃ paṃ paṃ! O you in the form of a preta, the conqueror of the pledge (samaya), in the crushing of Sumbha and Nisumbha;
when love has entered the battle, may he who effects creation and destruction be victorious and triumph!
Hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ! O Siddhicaṇḍī, who removes the fear of worldly existence through the resonance of the syllable Hrīṃ, salutations to you! || 5 ||
HŪṂ-kārī, whose form is Time, with a mouth full of human flesh, thick and fierce with a lolling tongue;
HŪṂ-kārī of terrible sound, the supreme crest-lock, the snatcher, with tawny eyes; born in the mud, of noble birth, CURU CURU CURUTE! O passionate one with a throat like a reed-stalk!
O Skeleton-like One, O Night of Doom, O Blessed Lady, Giver of Boons, Siddhicaṇḍī, homage be to you!

*Ṣṭrīṃ ṣṭrīṃ ṣṭrīṃ*: she who is praised by the three worlds through the sound of the syllable *ṣṭrīṃ*; most terrible among the terrible, the form of Time (*kāla-rūpa*) in the sounds *kaṃ kaṃ kaṃ*; she who roars with the sound *ghughuritaghurita*;
*ghuṃ ghumā*: she whose form is the *bindu*; *dhūṃ dhūṃ dhūṃ*: she of smoky color (*dhūmra-varṇā*), who wanders throughout the worlds with the noose of Time and the trident.
O Siddhicaṇḍī, who takes on various intense forms and removes my fear, salutations to you! || 7 ||

Jhrīṃ jhrīṃ jhrīṃ! O you whose mass of splendor spreads from the sound of *jhrīṃ*, holding a skull in your left hand, and with *khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ* in your right hand a sword that resounds with the *ḍimaḍima* of a *ḍamaru*;
beautifully adorned with garlands of severed heads, decorated with ornaments of Rudra-garlands, *ruṃ ruṃ ruṃ*, you who have a long tongue and are terrifying.
O Goddess Śrī Ugracaṇḍī, O Blessed One, O Giver of Boons, O Siddhicaṇḍī, homage to you! || 8 ||
Resembling the color of dawn, marked with the sword, the *pheṭaka*, and the bindu, the great goddess Kāmarūpiṇī Ugracaṇḍī—homage be to you! 9.
The Śrī Caṇḍikā-daṇḍaka-stotra is completed.
